items.summary: After clicking 'Send OTP' button, display a 'Resend OTP' button/link below the 6-digit OTP input fields with pearl blue text color (#7FB3D5). Initially disable the button for 60 seconds with a countdown timer showing 'Resend in 60s', 'Resend in 59s', etc., counting down to 'Resend OTP' when the timer ends.
When the 60-second timer expires and the user clicks the enabled 'Resend OTP' button, send a new OTP to the same mobile number and reset the countdown timer to 60 seconds again.

Style the 'Resend OTP' button with pearl blue text (#7FB3D5), gold underline/glow effect on hover, and subtle pulse animation when enabled. Display timer text in small pearl off-white color (#F5F5F0) with gold accent on the countdown number. Maintain the dark luxury theme with black background and pearl blue/gold accents. Ensure responsive design for mobile devices.

Implement a maximum of 3 resend attempts within a 10-minute window using localStorage to track timer state and attempt count. If the user exceeds 3 resends, display the message 'Too many attempts. Try again after 10 minutes' and disable the resend button until the 10-minute window expires.
On successful OTP resend, display a toast notification with the message 'New OTP sent!' using gold border and pearl off-white text (#F5F5F0), consistent with the premium dark luxury theme.
Do not modify any existing functionality for Send OTP, OTP verification, Internet Identity integration, or other parts of the login flow. Only add the Resend OTP feature with timer and attempt limit.
